item.title: BBC visits aftermath of Israeli strike on Lebanon that killed family as IDF targets Hezbollah
item.summary: A relative tells BBC those killed were civilians and not Hezbollah operatives, but the Israel Defense Forces says it was targeting "terrorist infrastructure".

item.title: US names six crew killed in refuelling plane crash in Iraq
item.summary: The aircraft was on a combat mission as part of ongoing US operations against Iran when it crashed in western Iraq on Thursday.

item.title: Ugandan opposition leader goes abroad after two months in hiding
item.summary: Uganda's military chief has said Bobi Wine is wanted "dead or alive", although some ministers have denied he is being sought.

item.title: 'Gruesome' war bets fuel calls for crackdown on prediction markets
item.summary: Predictions markets have hosted millions of dollars of bets related to the war in Iran.

item.title: Russia exploiting Iran war, Zelensky says after fresh bombardment
item.summary: Volodymyr Zelensky cast concern over the supply of air-defence missiles after a heavy overnight attack kills at least five.

item.title: Iraq taking private plane to Mexico for World Cup play-off
item.summary: Iraq will travel to Mexico by private plane for their World Cup play-off despite calls from coach Graham Arnold to postpone the match amid the escalating US-Israeli war with Iran, the country's FA president Adnan Dirjal says.

item.title: Hamas urges key ally Iran to halt attacks on Gulf states
item.summary: The Palestinian group also affirms Tehran's right to defend itself from "aggression" by the US and Israel.

item.title: Israeli forces kill Palestinian couple and two of their children in occupied West Bank
item.summary: Mohammed, aged five, and Othman, aged seven, were killed alongside their parents, the Palestinian health ministry says.

item.title: Trump urges UK and other nations to send warships to Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: The US president says he hopes China, France, Japan and South Korea will also send ships to defend the key oil shipping route.

item.title: Cuban protesters ransack Communist office as energy crisis deepens
item.summary: Discontent is mounting over rolling blackouts and shortages of food, fuel and medicine, exacerbated by a US blockade.
